description: AV->AR round-trip pilot, 6-group summary, re-scored with a random-text control alongside the original mismatched-explanation control. Direction-only cosine at layer 20; matched reuses saved AV explanations (deterministic AR reconstruction); random control = 20 seeded random-token texts reconstructed by the AR. Higher matched and larger gap_vs_random = better round-trip fidelity.
control_random: 20 random-token texts x 50 tokens, reconstructed by AR, scored against each original
control_mismatch: reconstructions of OTHER vectors' real explanations
takeaway: bread top SV, all-caps top SV, and both avg activations clear the random-text floor convincingly; EM-organism rank-32 SVD and trailing/noise SVs do not. Random text is a lower floor than mismatched explanations, especially for avg_lora (0.403 vs 0.549), confirming that real explanations share a common average-activation direction that inflated the mismatched control.
